meaning.en: Danish socket (DS 60884-2-D1, Type K), shown as the socket face seen from the front, earth hole down
meaning.de: Dänische Steckdose (DS 60884-2-D1, Typ K), dargestellt als Steckdosenfläche von vorn, Schutzkontakt unten

standard.source: DS 60884-2-D1 not consulted; contact layout taken from the OpenPlugDB front view "Danish Type K socket-outlet (female), mating face, earth hole down" (https://github.com/ovarilo/openplugdb/blob/main/public/images/connectors/ds-60884-2-d1/earthed-socket-front.svg, retrieved 2026-11-08), drawn from Wikipedia "AC power plugs and sockets" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AC_power_plugs_and_sockets, retrieved 2026-11-08); Sikkerhedsstyrelsen (Danish Safety Technology Authority) "Vejledning – Markedsføring af stikkontakter" (https://www.sik.dk/sites/default/files/2026-05/Vejledning%20til%20markedsf%C3%B8ring%20af%20stikkontakter.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-08)
